text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian newspapers on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Frederick Chiluba, on a two-nation tour of the Far East, arrived in London on Sunday in transit for a day's stop-over.
- Lever Brothers invests $9 million in Zambia.
- The regional manager of the Tanzania-Zambia Railway Authority (TAZARA), Sailas Mantantilo, shot himself dead in unexplained circumstances.
- The former President Kenneth Kaunda says President Frederick Chiluba will have to answer for his actions when he leaves office.
